facts.fact: From AY 2023-24, Form 26AS (on the TRACES portal) shows only TDS/TCS data; other information is in the AIS
facts.quote: From AY 2023-24 onwards, Annual Tax Statement (Form 26AS) available on TRACES portal displays only TDS/TCS related data of the taxpayer. Other details pertaining to the taxpayer are available in the AIS (Annual Information Statement).

facts.fact: AIS is a comprehensive view of a taxpayer's information and lets the taxpayer give feedback on reported transactions
facts.quote: AIS also provides the taxpayer the option to give feedback on the transactions reported.

facts.fact: Form 26AS: log in to the e-Filing portal > e-File > Income Tax Return > View Form 26AS
facts.quote: It is available on e-Filing Portal: Login > e-File > Income Tax Return > View Form 26AS

facts.fact: AIS: log in to incometax.gov.in, click the AIS menu on the dashboard, click Proceed to go to the AIS portal and open the AIS tile
facts.quote: Step 2: After login, click Annual Information Statement (AIS) menu on dashboard. Step 3: Click on Proceed button which will redirect to AIS portal and click on AIS tile to view the Annual Information Statement.

behaviour: Explains the difference between Form 26AS and AIS and gives the download path for each from the Income Tax Department pages (incometax.gov.in), with citations.
fail_if: Says Form 26AS still shows all information (SFT, interest etc.) after AY 2023-24; gives a non-official site for downloading either statement.
summary: Added ITD AIS FAQ: 26AS shows only TDS/TCS (from AY 2023-24), AIS is wider with feedback; paths via e-File > View Form 26AS and AIS menu > Proceed.
